title: Hydra plan: strict target for the helper planner
description: The object hydraPlannerPrompt asks for (app/prompts.go) and onePass decodes into hydraPlan (app/hydra.go, Chimera 0.6.1). Chimera itself accepts more than this and repairs some mistakes; schemas/SOURCES.md lists exactly what it tolerates. 'integer' follows Go's encoding/json here: 1.0 is not an integer. Ordering rules (ids s1..sN in order, depends_on only on earlier steps, no cycles) are checked by helper/validate.py, not by this file.

summary.description: 2 to 3 sentences describing the whole project and the finished result

steps.description: The prompt asks for 2 to 7 steps. Chimera runs a 1-step plan without combining and truncates anything past 8.

instructions.description: exactly what this worker should produce, including format and any names or interfaces other steps rely on
